title: RotorQuant: Block-Diagonal Clifford Rotor KV-Cache Compression
summary: An open-source project providing high-efficiency KV-cache compression for LLMs using Clifford algebra rotors. It achieves extreme sub-4-bit quantization with significantly lower computational overhead and better perplexity than dense orthogonal transformation methods.
research_notes: Outperforms Google's TurboQuant with a 44x reduction in parameters and up to 5x faster prefill speeds while maintaining higher output quality.

evolution.summary: Originally based on 3D Clifford rotors, the project expanded into IsoQuant (4D) and the highly optimized PlanarQuant (2D) variants. It now includes fused CUDA and Metal kernels and has been integrated into llama.cpp as a drop-in 3-bit cache compression solution.
